expected: A saved browser-local project should render independently of the full catalogue; catalogue-backed panels may load it on demand.
actual: The saved Direction C project fails to open when /data/catalog.json returns an injected HTTP 503. Workbench shows Local project Recovery and says no project was opened, while stating saved browser records remain unchanged.
reproduction: On the live v30 Site, enter the exact 500-person employee-experience brief through the visible Compose form.
Generate three directions, open Direction C in Workbench, and confirm the project shows Local SAVED.
Reload the same Workbench URL with a pre-document fetch wrapper returning HTTP 503 for /data/catalog.json.
At both 1440x900 and 390x844, observe the Local project Recovery page instead of the saved project.

console.message: The platform's inline bootstrap is blocked by the strict response CSP; this is separately tracked as AUD-342.

network.detail: Synthetic HTTP 503 returned by a pre-document fetch wrapper; it was not an upstream request.

rootCause: Deployed v30 couples full catalogue loading and validation with saved-project restoration, making catalogue availability a prerequisite to rendering an already saved manifest.
limitations: The 503 is intentional fault injection; no real upstream outage occurred.
The CSP console error is platform-injected and unrelated to the saved-project failure.
